newsitem.title: UK: Kuwait to begin supplying Milazzo refinery on Mar.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait to begin supplying Milazzo refinery on Mar.

text.p: Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) will begin supplying the Milazzo refinery in Sicily with crude oil and feedstock on March 1 as part of its 50-50 joint venture with Agip Petroli, a KPC source said.
The source said most of the 120,000 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil and feedstock it will supply Milazzo will come from North Africa, Russia and Nigeria.
By the end of the year, KPC hopes to have signed contracts to supply the bulk of its obligations to the refinery, the source said.
In 1996, KPC and Agip Petroli, the refining and marketing arm of Italian energy group ENI, signed the deal worth around one trillion lire ($650 million).

The accord gave KPC a 50 percent stake in the refinery and 336 filling stations in Italy and provides for the upgrade of the refinery which has an annual capacity of about eight million tonnes (160,000 bpd).
